CustomMetadata.label: Account PriceBook Region Reassignment - Before Insert

values.value: Migrated from Account_Before_Save_Flow (before-save, create only via source ISNEW() guard - now expressed as before-insert-only context instead of an in-flow check): reassigns OwnerId to the AccountOwnerId label value and sets Region__c = 'NA' for new Accounts when the running user's Price_Book_Region__c includes both NA and CSA.
